newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Export sets bonus, rights issues.
newsitem.headline: Korea Export sets bonus, rights issues.

text.p: Korea Export Packaging Industry Co Ltd said on Thursday it intends to offer a 27-for-100 rights issue in April and a 15-for-100 bonus issue in May as part of a plan to raise its paid-in capital to 20 billion won.
The company's paid-in capital is currently 13 billion won.

A Korea Export statement said it plans a rights issue of 878,260 shares, of which 20 percent would be offered to its employees. The rest will be allocated to shareholders registered as of March 31 for rights.
The rights issue price will be set at a 20 percent discount to the base price, which will be decided later.
Subscription is scheduled for April 29 and 30, with payment due by May 13.
The company also plans a bonus issue of 521,740 common shares for distribution to shareholders on May 15, it said. The face value of each share will be 5,000 won.
On Thursday, Korea Export's shares fell 400 won at 22,100 won. -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5644
